{"action":"final","query":{"op":"none","scope":null,"id":null,"text":null,"start":null,"end":null,"offset":null,"derived_op":null,"groupBy":null},"diagnosis":"softmax drops the reduced axis from both its maximum and denominator when keep_dims=False. Subsequent broadcasting aligns remaining dimensions from the right rather than restoring the requested axis. For shape [2,2], dim=1, this applies row statistics across columns: the actual device output is [0.49999997, 0.02993836, 16.55772781, 0.00857748], with all four elements incorrect and maximum absolute error 15.605154. The dim=0 control passes all four elements because right-aligned broadcasting happens to restore that leading axis correctly. Keep the reduced axis as a singleton in both internal reductions so subtraction and division broadcast along the requested axis and preserve the input shape. Retain the public signature and division rounding option. Compilation and post-repair device results are unavailable; the repair is supported by the source and before-repair observations.","locations":[{"source_id":"source-07","start_line":53,"end_line":64},{"source_id":"test-kernel","start_line":4,"end_line":9}],"citations":[{"case_id":"softmax-axis-00","evidence_ids":["observation-softmax-axis-00"]},{"case_id":"softmax-axis-01","evidence_ids":["observation-softmax-axis-01"]}],"edits":[{"source_id":"source-07","old":"    z = x - max(x, _dim, keep_dims=keep_dims)
    num = math.exp(z)
    den = sum(num, _dim, keep_dims=keep_dims)
    return math.fdiv(num, den, ieee_rounding)","new":"    # Retain the reduction axis so statistics broadcast along that axis.
    z = x - max(x, _dim, keep_dims=True)
    num = math.exp(z)
    den = sum(num, _dim, keep_dims=True)
    return math.fdiv(num, den, ieee_rounding)"}]}
